# Dishcuss

> > A visual search engine specializing in photo discovery and curated image galleries.

Dishcuss enables users to explore and discover images through visual search technology. The platform features curated content spanning diverse subjects including travel destinations like the Azores, regional photography from Maryland, and cultural landmarks such as the Opera Garnier.
